sentences.text: At the reset of floating rates, a UCB may, at its option, provide borrowers a choice to switch to a fixed rate, so the rule is permissive rather than mandatory.
The applicable UCB direction also says borrowers may switch to a fixed interest rate only where such an option is provided by the bank.
A bank policy document likewise says the Bank may, at its option, offer the borrower a choice to switch to a fixed rate at the time of reset.
